results.title: Gazer
results.overview: Frankie, a young mother with dyschronometria, struggles to perceive time. Using cassette tapes for guidance, she takes a risky job from a mysterious woman to support her family, unaware of the dark consequences that await.

results.title: Bull Run
results.overview: Follows Bobby Sanders, an ex-pro-hockey-player-turned-junior-banker as he navigates the peculiar and somewhat surreal world of high finance and faces life's meaning within this gilded cage.

results.title: Luderdale
results.overview: A mysterious outsider travels to a Florida beach town in 1980 and soon finds himself more inside than he ever imagined when he befriends two on-the-run criminals with dangerous ties to people he fears most.

results.title: Infarct
results.overview: The documentary INFARCT tells the poignant and heartfelt story of two friends whose lives are suddenly turned upside down. A story about unconditional friendship, vulnerability, disarray, acceptance, determination, and working toward a new future. Because a stroke never happens to just one person, and its consequences are carried together.  A story of two friends who reincarnate within their lifetime.  With INFARCT, Viggo and Peter pay tribute to what remains after the blow, and give a face to what so often stays invisible: the impact on relationships, the struggle, and the hopeful perspective. They invite reflection and conversation about what connects us when everything changes.

results.title: Bloody Housewarming
results.overview: A couple’s date is interupted by a neighbour’s invitation.

results.title: Kaleidoscope
results.overview: « And even upside down, it’s beautiful somehow »

results.title: Healing Andy
results.overview: When Andy gets left at the altar, his best friends turn his Italian honeymoon into a ‘bros trip’ for the world to see. But as their influencer-fueled getaway spirals into a nightmare, they soon realise some things aren’t meant to be filmed.

results.title: Lifewasters
results.overview: Short film regarding lolcows and parasocial relationships from indie animator Victoria Vincent

results.title: Seed
results.overview: The story of a woman, Fiona, who has been struggling to get pregnant. Because she has become obsessed with wanting a baby, she now suffers from insomnia and her grip on reality begins to elude her. After exploring her plant-filled garden one moonlit night, she receives a supernatural visitation in a dream. In the weeks and months that follow, she begins to experience symptoms of pregnancy, although the medical establishment believes her to be delusional. As it turns out, however, there is something growing inside her - but not what one might expect.

results.title: Ikaros
results.overview: It is the year 2084, and humanity depends on precious metals and gases from space. The crew of a spacecraft returns from a mining expedition in a neighboring system with a life-changing amount of noble gas. While celebrating their future wealth, the crew notices a warning signal on the radar. Searching for an escape route, the spacecraft drives into an oil bubble. The captain is faced with a stalled engine, a leaking hull, and an injured crew member. The situation worsens when another crew member, after exiting the ship, can no longer get back inside.

results.title: Denu
results.overview: Set during pre-independence years, with the traditional mak yong performance used as a means of spreading political messages.

results.title: The Demon Prince
results.overview: The movie The  Demon Prince (Hoàng Tử Quỷ) marks the first collaboration between CJ HK Entertainment and the duo Producer Hoang Quan – Director Tran Huu Tan from ProductionQ. The film is inspired by the famous horror novel Lý Triều Dị Truyện by author Phan Cuong. This fictional collection, steeped in mystique and set during Vietnam's Ly Dynasty, builds on folklore about ghosts, dark magic, courtly secrets, and popular fears. The work opens up a world where forgotten legends come to life, reflecting the greed, ambition, and obsessions within every human being.  The film The  Demon Prince (Hoàng Tử Quỷ) is expected to premiere in cinemas nationwide starting from December 5, 2025.

results.title: Oversabi Aunty
results.overview: A zealous church usher's mission to "fix" everyone backfires as her moral crusade wreaks havoc on family life, culminating at a wedding introduction that forces her to face the consequences of her religious fervor.

results.title: Surrender
results.overview: Triggered and wanting to escape her past trauma, Naomi, a young Asian American female, falls into the world of blackjack to regain a sense of control but finds herself addicted to the game.

results.title: Shorthanded

results.overview: On January 8th, 2015, a man with a black umbrella broke into 818 Hilltop Drive at 3:38a.m., committing a double murder.  The investigation that ensued proved that some murders shouldn’t be solved.

results.title: Not What You Think
